records.source: Nothing here imports torch, cellpose or any GPU stack — pandas, numpy and the standard library only — so the Qt screen can compute agreement without waking a 4-second import chain.
records.translation: 여기서는 torch, cellpose 또는 어떤 GPU 스택도 가져오지 않으므로 — pandas, numpy와 표준 라이브러리만 사용 — Qt 화면이 4초짜리 가져오기 체인을 깨우지 않고 일치도를 계산할 수 있습니다.

records.context: Annotation columns are the ones the Annotate app writes: an ``INTEGER`` column added to ``png_list`` with ``ALTER TABLE … ADD COLUMN`` (see :func:`spacr.qt.annotate_engine.ensure_annotation_column`), holding the class the annotator pressed — ``1`` for a left click, ``2`` for a right click — and ``NULL`` for every extracted image region they have not looked at yet. Two annotators means two such columns over the same ``png_path`` rows.
records.label: spacr.agreement#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Annotation columns are the ones the Annotate app writes: an ``INTEGER`` column added to ``png_list`` with ``ALTER TABLE … ADD COLUMN`` (see :func:`spacr.qt.annotate_engine.ensure_annotation_column`), holding the class the annotator pressed — ``1`` for a left click, ``2`` for a right click — and ``NULL`` for every crop they have not looked at yet. Two annotators means two such columns over the same ``png_path`` rows.
records.translation: 어노테이션 열은 Annotate 앱이 기록하는 열입니다. ``INTEGER`` 열이 ``png_list``에 ``ALTER TABLE … ADD COLUMN``으로 추가되며(:func:`spacr.qt.annotate_engine.ensure_annotation_column` 참조), 어노테이터가 누른 클래스 — 왼쪽 클릭은 ``1``, 오른쪽 클릭은 ``2`` — 를 담고, 아직 보지 않은 모든 크롭에는 ``NULL``을 담습니다. 어노테이터가 두 명이면 같은 ``png_path`` 행에 대해 그러한 열이 두 개 있습니다.

records.context: ``cohens_kappa(a, b)`` κ for one pair of label vectors. ``fleiss_kappa(matrix)`` κ for three or more annotators, from a subjects × categories count matrix. ``agreement_report(db_path, columns)`` the whole picture for a database: per-pair κ, overall κ, per-class κ, confusion matrices, and the counts that make them interpretable. ``disagreements(db_path, columns)`` exactly the rows the annotators labelled differently, for review. ``format_agreement(report)`` the report as text.
records.label: spacr.agreement#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: ``cohens_kappa(a, b)`` κ for one pair of label vectors. ``fleiss_kappa(matrix)`` κ for three or more annotators, from a subjects × categories count matrix. ``agreement_report(db_path, columns)`` the whole picture for a database: per-pair κ, overall κ, per-class κ, confusion matrices, and the counts that make them interpretable. ``disagreements(db_path, columns)`` exactly the rows the annotators labelled differently, for review. ``format_agreement(report)`` the report as text.
records.translation: ``cohens_kappa(a, b)`` 레이블 벡터 한 쌍에 대한 κ. ``fleiss_kappa(matrix)`` 대상 × 범주 개수 행렬에서 계산한, 세 명 이상의 어노테이터에 대한 κ. ``agreement_report(db_path, columns)`` 데이터베이스에 대한 전체 그림: 쌍별 κ, 전체 κ, 클래스별 κ, 혼동 행렬, 그리고 이를 해석할 수 있게 하는 개수. ``disagreements(db_path, columns)`` 검토를 위해 어노테이터들이 서로 다르게 레이블한 바로 그 행들. ``format_agreement(report)`` 텍스트로 된 보고서.

records.context: Map Barcodes has to be told three things it cannot guess: which mate carries each barcode, whether the reference table is stored in the same orientation as the reads, and where in the read the barcode sits.  Getting any of them wrong produces a processing session that finishes normally and maps nothing, because every stage after the extraction window is working on the wrong bases.  This module reads a bounded sample of the reads, measures each reference table against them in both orientations, and turns the measurements into settings the mapping run can use. It holds no graphical code and opens no dialogs, so the same engine serves the live search in the interface, a notebook, and the tests.

records.translation: Map Barcodes는 추측할 수 없는 세 가지를 알려 주어야 합니다. 어느 메이트가 각 바코드를 지니는지, 참조 테이블이 리드와 같은 방향으로 저장되어 있는지, 그리고 리드에서 바코드가 어디에 위치하는지입니다. 이 중 하나라도 틀리면 실행은 정상적으로 끝나지만 아무것도 매핑하지 못합니다. 추출 창 이후의 모든 단계가 잘못된 염기에 대해 작업하기 때문입니다. 이 모듈은 리드의 제한된 표본을 읽고, 각 참조 테이블을 두 방향 모두로 리드와 대조하여 측정하며, 그 측정 결과를 매핑 실행이 사용할 수 있는 설정으로 바꿉니다. 그래픽 코드를 담지 않고 대화 상자를 열지 않으므로, 같은 엔진이 인터페이스의 라이브 검색, 노트북, 테스트에 모두 쓰입니다.

records.context: A short barcode turns up in a long read by pure coincidence.  Thirty-two distinct eight base barcodes scanned across a hundred and fifty base read have about a seven percent chance of a spurious match, so a table that is genuinely absent still reports roughly seven percent of reads as hits.  Reporting that rate as a finding would misidentify the table as present and could configure a mapping that yields nothing.  Every rate this module reports therefore arrives with the rate expected by chance for that table against those reads, and with the ratio between them.  Nothing is called present unless it stands well clear of its own coincidence rate.

records.translation: 짧은 바코드는 긴 리드에서 순전히 우연으로 나타납니다. 서로 다른 8염기 바코드 32개를 150염기 리드 전체에 걸쳐 스캔하면 약 7퍼센트의 확률로 가짜 일치가 생기므로, 실제로는 없는 테이블도 여전히 리드의 약 7퍼센트를 히트로 보고합니다. 그 비율을 발견으로 보고하면 테이블이 존재한다고 잘못 식별하여 아무것도 산출하지 않는 매핑을 구성할 수 있습니다. 따라서 이 모듈이 보고하는 모든 비율에는 그 리드에 대한 그 테이블의 우연 기대 비율과 둘 사이의 비가 함께 제공됩니다. 자체 우연 비율보다 충분히 높지 않으면 어떤 것도 존재한다고 판정하지 않습니다.

records.translation: 일치 위치

records.context: Enrichment over chance answers whether the sequences are in the reads.  It does not answer whether they are the laboratory microplate barcodes.  Sequencing adapters are fixed sequences repeated in every read, and a handful of barcodes in any table will resemble part of an adapter closely enough to match it.  That produces a large, perfectly real enrichment driven by two barcodes sitting in the adapter rather than by a laboratory microplate.  The measurement that separates the two is position.  A laboratory microplate barcode occupies one place in the construct and so lands at one offset in almost every read, which is exactly why an extraction window can be proposed for it at all.  A match scattered across the read cannot yield a window and is not treated as a finding, however enriched it is.

records.context: a single entry out of a ledger's ``edits`` list. Every structured-data name is optional, so an entry written by an older version — or one hand-trimmed in the JSON — loads instead of taking the whole ledger down with it. A missing structured-data name becomes an empty value whatever the field declares: ``""`` for ``kind``, ``when`` and ``who``, ``None`` for ``target``, ``0`` for ``n_changed``, ``{}`` for ``detail``. A missing ``when`` is therefore ``""`` and not the current time, so a reconstructed edit never claims a timestamp it does not have. Structured-data names this class does not know are dropped; put anything you want kept under ``detail``.
records.label: spacr.curation.CurationEdit.from_dict#1

records.source: a single entry out of a ledger's ``edits`` list. Every key is optional, so an entry written by an older version — or one hand-trimmed in the JSON — loads instead of taking the whole ledger down with it. A missing key becomes an empty value whatever the field declares: ``""`` for ``kind``, ``when`` and ``who``, ``None`` for ``target``, ``0`` for ``n_changed``, ``{}`` for ``detail``. A missing ``when`` is therefore ``""`` and not the current time, so a reconstructed edit never claims a timestamp it does not have. records.translation: 회귀 실행은 전체, 수준별, 선택된 계수 표를 고유한 이름의 ``results/<kind>[_n]`` 디렉터리에 기록합니다. 이 모듈은 사용 가능한 표를 유전자마다 정렬 가능한 하나의 행으로 결합하고, 백엔드가 제공하면 효과 추정값과 불확실성을 추가하며, 가이드 방향 일치도를 계산하고, 선택적인 유전자 메타데이터를 조인합니다.

records.context: Every number here rests on one choice: when is a predicted object the same object as a labelled one? The literature's answer is an IoU threshold, and the threshold is not a detail -- a model that finds every cell and outlines them loosely scores well at 0.5 and badly at 0.9, and a model that finds half of them perfectly does the opposite. That is why :func:`average_precision` reports the whole sweep from 0.5 to 0.9 rather than one number, and why every precision/recall figure states the threshold it was matched at.
records.label: spacr.scorecard#6
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Every number here rests on one choice: when is a predicted object THE SAME object as a labelled one? The literature's answer is an IoU threshold, and the threshold is not a detail -- a model that finds every cell and outlines them loosely scores well at 0.5 and badly at 0.9, and a model that finds half of them perfectly does the opposite. That is why :func:`average_precision` reports the whole sweep from 0.5 to 0.9 rather than one number, and why every precision/recall figure states the threshold it was matched at.
records.translation: 여기의 모든 숫자는 하나의 선택에 기반합니다. 예측된 객체는 언제 레이블된 객체와 같은 객체인가? 문헌의 답은 IoU 임계값이며, 임계값은 사소한 세부 사항이 아닙니다 -- 모든 세포를 찾되 윤곽을 느슨하게 그리는 모델은 0.5에서는 점수가 좋고 0.9에서는 나쁘며, 절반만 찾되 완벽하게 그리는 모델은 그 반대입니다. 그래서 :func:`average_precision`은 숫자 하나가 아니라 0.5에서 0.9까지의 전체 스윕을 보고하며, 모든 정밀도/재현율 수치는 매칭에 사용된 임계값을 명시합니다.

records.context: Pooled from the counts, not averaged from the ratios. records.context: The settings that produced a processing session are *not* in the processing-session folder: ``save_settings`` writes them to ``<src>/settings/train_test_<model_type>_<epochs>.csv`` as a ``Key,Value`` CSV. :func:`load_run` walks up from the processing-session folder to find it — but only as far as the processing session's own project root, which the layout above makes identifiable: ``<src>`` is the folder the ``model/`` tree hangs off. An ancestor above that belongs to a different project, and reading it would report somebody else's settings as this processing session's provenance, so the settings diff would show differences nobody configured and the answer would depend on where in the filesystem the project happened to sit. An ancestor above that belongs to a different project, and reading it would report somebody else's settings as this run's provenance, so the settings diff would show differences nobody configured and the answer would depend on where in the filesystem the project happened to sit. records.translation: 실행을 만든 설정은 실행 폴더에 *없습니다*. ``save_settings``는 이를 ``<src>/settings/train_test_<model_type>_<epochs>.csv``에 ``Key,Value`` CSV로 기록합니다. :func:`load_run`은 실행 폴더에서 위로 올라가며 이를 찾습니다 — 단, 실행 자체의 프로젝트 루트까지만이며, 위의 레이아웃 덕분에 이를 식별할 수 있습니다. ``<src>``는 ``model/`` 트리가 매달린 폴더입니다. 그보다 위의 상위 폴더는 다른 프로젝트에 속하며, 이를 읽으면 다른 사람의 설정을 이 실행의 출처 정보로 보고하게 되므로, 설정 차이가 아무도 구성하지 않은 차이를 보여 주고 답이 프로젝트가 파일 시스템의 어디에 놓였는지에 따라 달라지게 됩니다. :func:`_owns_this_run`을 참조하십시오.

records.context: ``run_ids`` the runs that contributed settings, in order. ``changed`` ``[{'key', 'values': {run_id: value}}]`` for structured-data names present in every contributing run whose values differ — the signal. ``env`` same shape, for structured-data names :func:`is_env_key` classifies as environment drift. Never merged into ``changed``. ``drift`` ``[{'key', 'present': [...], 'missing': [...]}]`` — schema drift. ``same`` / ``shared`` counts of unchanged and shared structured-data names. ``identical`` True when two or more runs contributed settings and nothing at all differs. Callers must say "no differences" rather than render an empty table. ``no_settings`` processing-session ids that had no settings to contribute. ``env_manifest`` the manifest ``env`` diff, when the folders are processing-session journal folders.
records.label: spacr.train_compare.diff_settings#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: ``run_ids`` the runs that contributed settings, in order. ``changed`` ``[{'key', 'values': {run_id: value}}]`` for keys present in every contributing run whose values differ — the signal. ``env`` same shape, for keys :func:`is_env_key` classifies as environment drift. Never merged into ``changed``. ``drift`` ``[{'key', 'present': [...], 'missing': [...]}]`` — schema drift. ``same`` / ``shared`` counts of unchanged and shared keys. ``identical`` True when two or more runs contributed settings and nothing at all differs. Callers must say "no differences" rather than render an empty table. ``no_settings`` run ids that had no settings to contribute. ``env_manifest`` the manifest ``env`` diff, when the folders are run-journal runs.
records.translation: ``run_ids`` 설정을 제공한 실행, 순서대로. ``changed`` ``[{'key', 'values': {run_id: value}}]`` 설정을 제공한 모든 실행에 존재하면서 값이 다른 키 — 신호입니다. ``env`` 같은 형태로, :func:`is_env_key`가 환경 변동으로 분류하는 키에 대한 것. ``changed``에 결코 합쳐지지 않습니다. ``drift`` ``[{'key', 'present': [...], 'missing': [...]}]`` — 스키마 변동. ``same`` / ``shared`` 변경되지 않은 키와 공유된 키의 수. ``identical`` 두 개 이상의 실행이 설정을 제공했고 아무것도 다르지 않으면 True. 호출자는 빈 표를 렌더링하는 대신 "no differences"라고 말해야 합니다. ``no_settings`` 제공할 설정이 없었던 실행 id. ``env_manifest`` 폴더가 실행 기록 실행일 때, 매니페스트 ``env`` 차이.
